decisions.reason: The accent remains required to derive from the Hero V geometry. Refining the Hero V's right-arm construction does not change that derivation rule or require a separate candidate-state update.

The closing V remains derived from the Hero V geometry. The source refines the Hero V's internal right-arm logic without changing the candidate's derivation rule or shared-characteristics requirement.
The source concerns only the Hero V's right arm and does not alter the deferred E and L letterform requirements.
The source changes geometric construction of the Hero V but does not change the deferred champagne material treatment or its role relative to the resolved design.
The Hero V right-arm refinement does not change the deferred requirement for unified full-wordmark kerning.
The source does not change the closing V's smaller, subordinate prominence relative to the Hero V.
